content:
Tim Cook tonight posted on X announcing that Apple will make a donation to support those affected by wildfires in southern Europe. Details below.

Apple to Support Southern Europe Relief Efforts

According to BBC reporting, wildfires in Portugal, Spain and France over the past few weeks have forced more than 300,000 people to evacuate their homes.

With temperatures forecast to remain high, firefighters on the front line will continue to face difficult conditions in controlling the blazes.

Whenever such natural disasters occur, Apple typically announces a donation to support relief and recovery efforts. Tim Cook did just that tonight with a post on X:

Cook's announcement comes seven months after Apple pledged an undisclosed amount toward relief and rebuilding efforts for devastating storms in Asia; just days earlier, the company had also pledged support following a fire at a residential building in Hong Kong.

Beyond stepping up during natural disasters and other emergencies, Apple also runs an internal giving programme called "Employee Giving," which through its matching gift policy has raised more than US$880 million to date.
